daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling introspective, Cap. Channel this vibe into organizing your thoughts and setting intentions. The universe is rewinding so you can see what actually matters.
daily.love: Your walls are softening today. If you've been guarded, someone trustworthy might slip through—let them. Singles: that random convo could spark something real if you're open to it.
daily.career: Your practical energy is magnetic rn. People are noticing how you handle things. This is a day to document your wins and remind yourself why you're actually capable. Trust your instincts.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding today. Touch grass literally, stretch intentionally, or just be still for a minute. Your nervous system will thank you for the pause.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to soften your edges, Cap. You've been grinding hard, and the cosmos is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Trust the process of vulnerability—it's actually your superpower right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language this week. Stop overthinking what you 'should' feel and lean into what actually makes your heart skip. Real connections thrive when you show up as yourself.
weekly.career: Your work momentum is building, but the real magic happens when you collaborate instead of going solo. Share your ideas freely and watch how others elevate them. This is your week to shine through teamwork, not just hustle.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness. It's not about pushing harder—it's about consistency and actually enjoying movement. Find something that feels good rather than punishing. Your nervous system will thank you for the shift.
